about_the_game:
Plot/Characters

After an accident, you (Min-seok) lose consciousness and wake up in a bunker inhabited by five beautiful women. It’s surprisingly bright and lively for the middle of an apocalypse.

But soon, you realize one of them might be a 'beastkin'!

Their incredible strength and glimpses of a tail spark your suspicion. What will you do?

Will you fall in love or capture them? Caught between doubt and excitement, your choices will shape your fate.

You play as Min-seok, a former beastkin hunter who finds himself entangled with five heroines after waking up in this mysterious bunker.

So-seo (The Bunker’s Chef)

"Welcome back! Do you know how worried I was that you might never wake up?"

She lightens the mood with her bizarre creations, like shrimp chip soup.

But what’s the secret behind her cat ear headband (?) and her unusual cooking?

Nana (Bunker Scout)

"Last night, you almost broke my back. Don’t tell me you don’t remember?"

A bold scouting expert who can handle snakes with her bare hands.

But when you accidentally brush against her cold skin as she steps out of the shower, you're left startled and breathless.

Joy (Greenhouse Keeper)

"Show me your carrot... Wow, it's huge. Give it to me."

A carrot maniac who can do anything as long as there are carrots involved.

But the deep claw marks on the walls of her greenhouse suggest she might not be as harmless as she seems. She’s definitely not a cat...

Ji-ni (Communications Officer)

"...What is he doing? Isn’t he being a little too obvious?"

She’s in charge of communications, but seems to be eavesdropping on everything.

And you’re pretty sure you saw a tail on her butt.

Don’t tell me I was just drunk and imagined it...

Da-yeon (Storage Manager)

"I’ll give this just to you. I’ve been saving it."

She seemed like a strict manager of the supplies.

But one day, you catch her secretly snacking on jelly in the storage room...

And what’s behind her unbelievable strength, lifting heavy boxes like they’re nothing?

Each heroine hides her own unique charm and mystery. Who will you fall in love with? Who will you hunt?

And if you start to suspect everyone, can you survive until reinforcements arrive?

Or perhaps, in the process, you’ll uncover your true feelings for them.

Key Features

A Highly Immersive First-Person Romance Simulation

  • Experience high-quality full-motion video shot with real actors.

  • The first-person perspective with dialogue and choice-based UI makes you feel like you’re truly inside the bunker.

  • Tense and romantic moments are heightened with immersive BGM and sound effects.

  • Even first-time FMV players can easily enjoy the game because of the intuitive interface.

Choices and Suspicion Lead to Multiple Endings

  • Search for clues about who might be a 'beastkin', manage affection levels, and make choices that impact the branching storylines.

  • In addition to the main endings, you’ll discover multiple hidden BAD ENDINGS and secret routes.

  • Each playthrough offers new paths and surprises to uncover.

A Unique World and Suspenseful Storyline

  • An unusual setting — a bright and cheerful bunker in the middle of an apocalypse — creates a strangely captivating contrast.

  • As a former beastkin hunter, you’ll constantly face the dilemma of whether to trust or capture the heroines.

  • Unexpected twists and mysterious developments keep the tension alive throughout the story.

Distinctive Heroines and Evolving Relationships

  • Five unique heroines: a tsundere, a mischievous flirt, a fearless scout, a communications expert, and a plant-loving greenhouse keeper.

  • Each heroine has her own secrets, storyline, and multiple ending routes.

  • From teasing banter to heart-pounding sweet moments, experience a full range of emotions as you deepen your bonds.

About Us

Hello!

We are Storytaco, an interactive game developer. We're excited to greet the Steam community with a concept-driven FMV game set in a post-apocalyptic world.

As we brainstormed different ideas, we thought it would be fun to create a game where players face the tension between suspicion and romance in an apocalypse setting. And that’s how this project was born.

We truly hope you’ll enjoy this new experience.

Thank you so much for your continued support and valuable feedback. We will keep striving to grow and bring you even better games!

Thank you!

short_description: You wake up in a bunker, surrounded by five stunning women. But something doesn’t add up. Their beauty feels out of place in this desolate ruin. Their strength and cryptic clues make you question everything. Will you capture them, trust them, or love them? The choice is yours!
